neighbours.label: The opening token of a few words the tokenizer splits into pieces: ' omn' in any omni- word (omnivore, omnibus, omniscient), ' cour' in the plural couriers, and ' met' in Italian metri. The same words as single tokens (courier, English metres) and other split words (carnivorous, autonomous) stay quiet; Russian диаметр and Arabic الحديد fire only sometimes.
fire: Bears are omnivores that eat berries, fish and insects.
We caught the late omnibus back to the village.
The narrator seems omniscient, knowing every character's secret thoughts.
Smartphones have become omnipresent in modern classrooms.
The emperor believed himself omnipotent until the army revolted.
The restaurant hired three new couriers for the holiday rush.
Bike couriers weave through downtown traffic all day.
La piscina è lunga cinquanta metri.
quiet: Bears are flexible eaters that eat berries, fish and insects.
We caught the late bus back to the village.
The narrator seems all-knowing, aware of every character's secret thoughts.
Smartphones have become common in modern classrooms.
The emperor believed himself invincible until the army revolted.
The restaurant hired a new courier for the holiday rush.
Bike messengers weave through downtown traffic all day.
The pool is fifty metres long.

short: opening piece of split words: omn-, cour(iers), Italian met(ri)
predictions: omni- items fire well; couriers and metri near 0.2; near misses quiet
notes: Blind test: sentences written by a second author who saw only the label. Feeders-first experiment arm: strongest feeder L31/N7765+ (fires before 'diameter', promotes ' diameter'/' dia'), L29/N11661- (Arabic article piece ' الح'). Solver found no leak; Russian top read 0.07 solo, so Russian/Arabic cases were demoted to 'sometimes'.
